description: This Java class implements decoding functionality for quoted-printable encoding as defined in RFC 1521. It provides a static method to decode a byte array of quoted-printable characters back into the original byte array.

classes.name: QuotedPrintable
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to decode quoted-printable encoded byte arrays.

methods.name: decodeQuotedPrintable
methods.description: Decodes quoted-printable encoded byte arrays into their original byte array forms, reversing the encoding process as per RFC 1521.
